## Overview

## Project Location
`tests/Birko.Random.Tests/`

## Test Framework
xUnit + FluentAssertions

## Dependencies
- Birko.Random (via .projitems import)

## Structure
- `Providers/` — Tests for all IRandomProvider implementations
- `Distributions/` — Tests for statistical distributions
- `Sequences/` — Tests for ID and token generators
- `Noise/` — Tests for Perlin and Simplex noise
